name: io.github.aryaminus/socials-assistant
description: Creator analytics vault. Pull your own TikTok/Instagram/Facebook/YouTube analytics into a permanent local history vault, digest weekly performance, and draft brand outreach from verified numbers.

tools.name: connection_status
tools.description: Connected social accounts, token health, vault history depth.

tools.name: connect_youtube
tools.description: Connect YouTube via Google OAuth (browser flow).

tools.name: connect_meta
tools.description: Connect Instagram + Facebook Page via one Meta OAuth flow.

tools.name: connect_tiktok
tools.description: Connect TikTok via official Display API OAuth.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Pull fresh analytics from all connected platforms into the vault.

tools.name: import_tiktok_csv
tools.description: Import a TikTok Studio CSV export (retention/watch-time/traffic data).

tools.name: vault_query
tools.description: Read-only SQL over the analytics vault.

tools.name: compare_periods
tools.description: Metric deltas: last N days vs prior N days, per platform and overall.

tools.name: top_content
tools.description: Best or worst content by any metric across platforms.

tools.name: audience_overview
tools.description: Audience demographics from the latest snapshot per platform.

tools.name: digest_data
tools.description: Structured weekly-digest payload across platforms.

tools.name: media_kit_data
tools.description: Verified numbers for media kits and brand pitches.

tools.name: outreach_log_add
tools.description: Log a drafted brand pitch.

tools.name: outreach_log_list
tools.description: List outreach attempts by status.

tools.name: outreach_log_update
tools.description: Update an outreach attempt's status or notes.

tools.name: profile_get
tools.description: Read the creator profile that tunes skills to this creator.

tools.name: profile_set
tools.description: Create/update the creator profile (niche, tone, rate floor, goals).

tools.name: pipeline_add
tools.description: Add a content idea/deliverable to the production pipeline.

tools.name: pipeline_list
tools.description: List pipeline items (production calendar) by stage.

tools.name: pipeline_update
tools.description: Move a pipeline item along (script_review → brand_review → approved → posted → measured).

tools.name: set_platform_credentials
tools.description: Store OAuth credentials for a platform (cloud-only; local servers use connect_* tools).

tools.name: refresh_token
tools.description: Force-refresh stored tokens for a platform (cloud-only).

tools.name: platform_oauth_url
tools.description: Start in-chat platform connection: returns consent URL + handle (cloud-only).

tools.name: platform_oauth_exchange
tools.description: Complete an in-chat platform connection with the pasted redirect URL (cloud-only).

installation.requirements: Build with pnpm after clone: pnpm install && pnpm build

remote.note: Self-host the Cloudflare Worker from infra/worker — see docs/hosting-cloudflare.md
